text:
Tess: Tiny update 100% personal7: I got promoted to Lead Designer and Sam and I celebrated our 3rd anniversary with a backyard taco night. Wanted to share the good vibes! :tada: :taco:
Marco: hell yes congrats!! lead designer!! tacos AND promo, what a combo 389
Asha: OMG CONGRATS TESS 60d when are we staging a small office taco lunch??
Tess: thinking low-key next Thursday 9/2 at noon in the lounge. Short slideshow of anniversary pics optional.
Lina: i can bring my famous pico & chips. also vote: hard tacos or soft tacos? reply with HARD or SOFT.
Priya: HARD all the way.
Marco: SOFT (but i'll accept either if there's guac).
Rob: HARD. i'll bring salsa verde and a speaker for chill playlist.
Asha: SOFT for the fold. also can we put up a tiny "congrats" banner?
EventsBot: Friendly reminder: file an events request for space and light budget. Link: https://company.internal/events-request. If you tag @Events, we can fast-track approval.
Tess: thanks EventsBot! i'll submit now and add Lina and Marco as co-organizers.
Priya: i'll bring dessert. mini churros? 
Marco: churros are a yes from me. 
Lina: noted. i'll email the team sign-up sheet after Events approval. congrats again, Tess!! :heart:
